headline: Spiking US Treasury Yields Drive Nervousness Across Global Bond Markets
summary: US Treasury yields surging to multi-decade highs are stoking volatility and nervousness among global bond market participants amid elevated political risk.
why: US Treasuries serve as the risk-free benchmark for global debt; multi-decade yield spikes elevate borrowing costs worldwide and weigh on equity valuations.

impacts.name: US 10-Year Treasury Yield
impacts.why: Yields spiked toward multi-decade highs amid heightened debt market risk pricing.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Yields hit multi-decade highs as market participants demanded higher premiums in response to rising political risks and fiscal concerns.
